milestone: browser text-to-speech verified on CPU-only laptop
significance: The last product-loop component is verified. The assistant now produces spoken answers entirely offline.
implementation: frontend/src/tts.ts, using the browser's Web Speech API (speechSynthesis + SpeechSynthesisUtterance)
voice_selected: Microsoft David (via en-US fallback when en-NG is not present)
known_limitations: Windows ships no Hausa voice by default. Hausa answers will be pronounced by an English voice with distorted phonetics.
Replacing this with a proper multilingual TTS service is a single-file change (frontend/src/tts.ts).
verification: speechSynthesis.speak(new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(...)) triggers the onend callback
The Play button in the UI is not displayed when speechSynthesis is unsupported
